postconditions.description: The number of rows in the pictures is between 1 and 30, inclusive.
The number of columns in the pictures is between 1 and 30, inclusive.
The number of copies made is between 0 and 100, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(picture[i][j] in '01' for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: Each element in the pictures is either 0 or 1.
The index of the initial picture is between 1 and k+1, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(operation[0] in '12' for operation in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation is either of type 1 (recolor a cell) or type 2 (make a copy).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= operation[1] <= n for operation in operations if operation[0] == '1')
postconditions.description: For an operation of type 1, the row index is between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= operation[2] <= m for operation in operations if operation[0] == '1')
postconditions.description: For an operation of type 1, the column index is between 1 and m, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= operation[1] <= k+1 for operation in operations if operation[0] == '2')
postconditions.description: For an operation of type 2, the index is between 1 and k+1, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(unique(operation[1] for operation in operations if operation[0] == '2') == list(range(1, k+2)))
postconditions.description: Each index from 1 to k+1 appears exactly once in the operations of type 2.

postconditions.expression: all(operation[1] != operation[2] for operation in operations if operation[0] == '1')
postconditions.description: For an operation of type 1, the cell to be recolored is not the same as the surrounding cells.

postconditions.expression: all(all(picture[i][j] in '01' for j in range(m)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each row in the pictures contains only 0s and 1s.

postconditions.expression: all(picture[i][0] == picture[i][-1] == 0 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The first and last elements of each row are 0.

postconditions.expression: all(picture[0][j] == picture[-1][j] == 0 for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: The first and last elements of each column are 0.
